beta.release_notes: SurveySync 9.0.1 improves the unified application shell and FieldBookSync workflow. This release adds consistent SurveySync ribbon navigation across modules, global themes with System/Light/Dark modes, updated SurveySync globe branding, restored application-wide Feedback Wizard with local-first retry handling, improved AI/OCR provider selection including Windows AI, Foundry Local, Gemini, OpenAI, and Anthropic options, safer PointID handling, and manual field-book review tools.

stable.release_notes: SurveySync 9.0.0 is the first major platform release replacing standalone FieldBook Sync with the modular SurveySync application. Existing FieldBook Sync projects and workflows are preserved through the FieldBookSync module. This release adds the shared SurveySync project architecture, module-tab navigation, ControlSync, COGOSync, ReportSync, QASync foundation, shared CRS/units, audit history, source integrity tracking, and the new SurveySync update platform.
